USURER-DEBT_POWER.title: Debt
USURER-DEBT_POWER.description: Backed by your real [gold]Gold[/gold]. At the end of your turn, increases by [blue]+20%[/blue] Interest (rounded up), then if [gold]Debt[/gold] is [blue]10[/blue] or more ([gold]Over-Leveraged[/gold]), lose [blue]Debt / 5[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and HP unless paused by [gold]Moratorium[/gold]. Unpaid [gold]Debt[/gold] is settled from your [gold]Gold[/gold] after combat.
USURER-DEBT_POWER.smartDescription: You owe [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold]. At the end of your turn, increases by [blue]+20%[/blue] Interest (rounded up), then if [gold]Debt[/gold] >= [blue]10[/blue], lose [blue]Debt / 5[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] and take [blue]Debt / 5[/blue] unpowered damage.

USURER-LIEN_POWER.title: Lien
USURER-LIEN_POWER.description: Whenever hit by an Attack, takes additional damage equal to its [gold]Lien[/gold] and forces the enemy to pay off [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Debt[/gold] (or grants [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] if you have [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold]).
